name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation Menu
description: A site navigation whose one dropdown panel resizes and glides between sections, which slide in from the side you move toward.

useCases: Marketing and docs site headers with a few top-level sections, such as Products, Solutions, and Resources, that each open a panel of links.
limitations: Horizontal, single-level menus only: nested submenus and a vertical sidebar layout are not styled. Below the sm breakpoint panels take the screen width minus a 1rem gutter and the list wraps, so a dedicated mobile drawer is still the better fit for long menus. The panel always opens below the triggers.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Put a NavigationMenuTrigger and NavigationMenuContent, or a single NavigationMenuLink, in each NavigationMenuItem, and name the root with aria-label. Reduced motion resizes the panel and swaps sections instantly.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/navigation-menu.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
